answer_1.quote: We compile LAB, a Long-document Attribution Benchmark of 6 long-document datasets with diverse tasks (QA, classification, fact checking, NLI and summarization) and domains (science, law, governmental and Wikipedia).
answer_1.outputs: Responses to questions, classifications, fact checks, NLI judgments, and summaries with cited evidence

answer_2.quote: For comparability with related work, we used established metrics to evaluate response quality: Exact match F1 (EM) on QASPER and Natural Questions, classification macro F1 (CF1) for Evidence Inference, Wice and ContractNLI and ROUGE-L for GovReport.

answer_3.quote: We select the best-performing model to evaluate attributability: Minicheck for QASPER, and TRUE for Natural Questions and GovReport.
